india: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa borders Afghanistan. Instability in a nuclear-armed neighbour matters for security across the region, including India.
lede: Imran Khan, a former cricket captain, became Pakistan's prime minister in 2018. He was voted out in 2022 and has been in jail since 2023. His party, PTI, says he is being targeted for political reasons; the government says he faces genuine criminal cases. The clash has spilled onto the streets again and again.

players.name: Imran Khan
players.role: Former PM and PTI founder. In jail since 2023.

players.name: PTI
players.role: Khan's party. Ran the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province until the emergency.

players.name: Federal government
players.role: Runs Pakistan from Islamabad. Says it is fighting rising terrorism.

players.name: President Asif Ali Zardari
players.role: Signed the emergency order for Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

players.name: Sohail Afridi
players.role: PTI chief minister of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. PTI says he was detained.

timeline.what: He loses a no-confidence vote in Parliament and is removed from office.
Khan is jailed after a corruption conviction. More cases follow.
In national elections, PTI-backed independents win the most seats, but rival parties form the government.
PTI's Sohail Afridi becomes chief minister of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

Talks fail on 4 Oct and PTI starts a long march for Khan's release. On 11 Oct the president puts Khyber Pakhtunkhwa under emergency rule, and Parliament approves it on 14 Oct amid opposition walkouts.

title: Pakistan's Imran Khan fight
